prompt: haproxy set-var ifgt iflt non-integer type check
answer:
For `set-var`:

- `ifgt` sets the variable only when its current value is greater than the sample.
- `iflt` sets it only when its current value is less than the sample.  
  [HAProxy `vars.c`](https://github.com/haproxy/haproxy/blob/5ddba59a/src/vars.c)

The comparison applies only when **both the existing variable and the new sample are scalar/integer-compatible**. The HAProxy regression test shows that:

- A string or binary variable causes `ifgt`/`iflt` to be ignored.
- An integer variable with a string sample also causes the condition to be ignored.
- Integer-to-integer comparisons work:
  - `5 ifgt 55` → not set
  - `5 ifgt 2` → set
  - `5 iflt 55` → set
  - `5 iflt 2` → not set

These non-compatible cases do not produce a type error in the test; the conditional comparison is simply ignored and the assignment proceeds. [Regression test](https://fossies.org/linux/haproxy/reg-tests/sample_fetches/cond_set_var.vtc)
